Subject: Pen test report / remediation status needed for procurement cutoff

Hi Soojin,

We're moving toward contract approval on our side and procurement has a hard cutoff of Tuesday, June 2 for security evidence required to progress the PO. Two requests from our side: 1) the most recent penetration test report (or a redacted summary if full report can't be shared) that covers production inference endpoints and the model serving runtime, and 2) a remediation status tracker (high/critical findings only) with target/actual completion dates.

Our security team also flagged two items from the SIG questionnaire that reference CVE remediations and temporary mitigations — can you confirm whether those are included in the tracker? If full report sharing requires an NDA or secure vault access, we can route through procurement.

This is gating the MAP/contract signing for our Q3 pilot. Appreciate a quick confirmation and an ETA.

Thanks,
Caroline
Caroline Peters
Senior Procurement Manager
Acme Enterprises

- If Acme requires the full tester report, we need a one-way NDA and secure access; we can provide a secure vault link (we've included a Drive/Vault option below).

Caroline — I expect to send the redacted executive summary and tracker first thing Monday morning (ET). If procurement needs earlier access to anything, let me know and I'll escalate.

Subject: Re: Pen test report / remediation status needed for procurement cutoff

Soojin / Marissa —

We ran the pen test with RedProbe in November 2025; scope included: production inference control plane, model-serving runtime (GPU nodes + inference API gateway), auth flows (token issuance), and S3-based model artifact storage. External network/service perimeter and customer-facing APIs were in scope; internal dev/test networks were out of scope.

Sharing guidance: full pen test contains tester notes and third-party contact info. We can provide: 1) a redacted executive summary (suitable for procurement/finops), 2) the full report via secure vault if Acme signs our standard one-way NDA, or 3) we can host a redaction-reviewed copy in our secure viewer for limited-time access.

Remediation status: I've exported the current high/critical tracker (attached as remediation-tracker-RDW-3567.csv). Short answers to Acme's asks:
- CVE-2025-3341 (inference runtime dependency): patched in prod on 2026-01-18, verification completed 2026-01-25 (see Jira RDW-SEC-482).
- CVE-2025-4019 (artifact registry auth issue): temporary mitigation applied 2026-02-02, full patch scheduled and completed 2026-04-10 (see Jira RDW-SEC-517).

I'll attach the redacted summary (PDF) for immediate sharing. If procurement requests the full PDF, please confirm whether Acme will sign the NDA or accept viewer access.

-David
David Kim
Head of Security, Redwood Inference
